title: Von Braun's team passed data to Argentine Nazis in Mexico

tellings.quote: >> that they were going in meeting Nazi counterparts coming from Argentina at border towns in Mexico and giving them data drops.

plain: In the late 1940s, the team of Wernher von Braun, the German rocket engineer brought to work for the United States after the war, crossed from Texas into Mexican border towns to meet Nazi contacts arriving from Argentina and hand them batches of data. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells this without naming a source. If true, Nazi networks were still trading rocket secrets after the war, right under American eyes.
